topic.title: Water Framework Directive / River Basin Management / No Deterioration
topic.source_contract: river basin district, water body and status, environmental objectives, pressure and pathway, baseline, deterioration assessment, protected-area objectives, mitigation, alternatives, permitting, decision, implementation and monitoring evidence

scope_guards: Location in a river basin district is not proof of an effect on a water body.
Water-body status is not an exact-site impact conclusion.
A generic water-quality assessment is not a WFD compliance assessment.
Proposed mitigation is not evidence that deterioration is avoided.
A planning decision is not an environmental permit.
Permit issue is not completed mitigation.
Monitoring commitments are not measured no-deterioration outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact water body, assessment, decision, mitigation and monitoring evidence.
